title: Digital Biosphere Architecture main constitutional coherence principles
title_zh: 数字生物圈架构主宪法一致性原则

principles.title: Compositional scale and replaceable coordination
principles.title_zh: 组合式规模与可替换协调
principles.statement: Prefer many bounded and composable entities with finite, replaceable and auditable coordination over an unbounded central intelligence.
principles.statement_zh: 优先通过大量有界、可组合主体以及有限、可替换、可审计的协调形成规模，而不是建设无限强中心。

principles.title: Dynamic and evidence-aware attention
principles.title_zh: 动态且证据感知的注意力
principles.statement: Participant selection may adapt to task, context and evidence, but it creates neither authority nor a permanent central controller.
principles.statement_zh: 参与者选择可以随任务、上下文和证据动态变化，但不得由此产生权威或永久中央控制器。

principles.title: Compatibility before invention
principles.statement: Audit and reuse compatible protocols, schemas, evidence formats and adapters before introducing a new overlapping mechanism.
principles.statement_zh: 引入新的重叠机制前，必须先审计并复用兼容的协议、Schema、证据格式和适配器。

principles.title: Human constitutional sovereignty
principles.statement: Agents and components may advise, verify and execute within scope, but only an explicit Human Decision may amend constitutional authority or authorize irreversible effects.
principles.statement_zh: 智能体与组件可以在范围内建议、核验和执行，但只有显式人类决策可以修改宪法权威或授权不可逆效果。

principles.title: Composition accountability
principles.statement: A composition must preserve the identity, task, permission, evidence and responsibility lineage of every participating entity and must be assessed as a composition.
principles.statement_zh: 组合必须保留每个参与主体的身份、任务、权限、证据与责任谱系，并对组合整体重新评估。

principles.title: Evidence-based change and revalidation
principles.title_zh: 基于证据的变化与重新核验
principles.statement: Material changes to context, dependencies, policy, permissions or composition invalidate inherited conclusions until bounded revalidation is complete.
principles.statement_zh: 上下文、依赖、策略、权限或组合发生实质变化时，既有结论必须失效并等待有界重新核验。

principles.title: Shared protocol is not a shared controller
principles.title_zh: 共享协议不等于共享控制器
principles.statement: Interoperability should converge on shared contracts while execution and enforcement remain distributed, scoped and owned by their canonical domains.
principles.statement_zh: 互操作应在共享契约上收敛，而执行与执法必须保持分布式、有范围并由规范责任域所有。

principles.title: Real-environment feedback before capability claims
principles.title_zh: 能力声明前需要真实环境反馈
principles.statement: Synthetic, local or document-level validation must not be elevated into cross-platform, scale, production, adoption or commercial claims without matching real-environment evidence.
principles.statement_zh: 缺少相匹配的真实环境证据时，不得把合成、本地或文档级验证提升为跨平台、规模、生产、采用或商业声明。

limitations: Human adoption is approved; normative effect begins only when this contract is reachable from canonical refs/heads/main.
No runtime, gateway, SDK, website or product behavior is changed.
